heroHeadline: Assembly Sets September 21 Vote to Bar 'Traitors' From Elections as Panama Recalls Ambassador in Regional Rebuke
heroSubtitle: National Assembly President Gustavo Porras confirmed the electoral reform excluding denationalized opposition figures will pass its first vote Sept. 21 — with binding ratification deferred to a legislature convening after Dec. 2027 — as ten governments plus the OAS and UN voiced concern and a Costa Rica-based rights collective marked the UN's Day of Victims of Enforced Disappearance by counting 23 Nicaraguans still forcibly disappeared among 60 registered political prisoners
